purpose: Record the fifth controlled team-match promotion batch, using a bulk exact-field-reference pass to resolve legacy provider semantics family-by-family rather than one field at a time.
promotion_rule: Promote packaged team-match fields when an exact legacy Opta F9 field key provides direct field-level semantics, existing FRL evidence shows no contradiction, and any historical blanks remain missing under the standing missingness contract. Existing zero-violation child<=parent checks are supporting consistency evidence, not substitutes for definitions.

important_semantic_resolutions.finalThirdEntries_penAreaEntries: Both fields now have direct independent entry definitions. No parent/child nesting is assumed or required.
important_semantic_resolutions.contest_family: totalContest and wonContest now have direct attempt/success semantics; challengeLost is separately defined as a missed challenge where the defender is beaten.
important_semantic_resolutions.directional_pass_families: leftsidePass/rightsidePass and passesLeft/passesRight remain separate source-native concepts rather than aliases.
important_semantic_resolutions.subsMade: Exact field-level definition resolves the team-match aggregate as number of substitutions made. Event-object reconciliation remains useful as corroboration but is no longer required merely to understand the source field.

explicitly_held_fields.redCard: FRL already exposes totalRedCard and the exact relationship between redCard and totalRedCard remains to be reconciled.
explicitly_held_fields.successfulFiftyFifty: No exact legacy field definition established in the bulk V5 reference pass.
explicitly_held_fields.successfulPutThrough: Legacy field documentation marks the concept as Bundesliga-specific, so numeric presence is insufficient for Premier League promotion.
explicitly_held_fields.attemptsIbox: No exact legacy attempts_ibox field definition established in V5.
explicitly_held_fields.attemptsObox: No exact legacy attempts_obox field definition established in V5.

governance_note: V5 is intentionally a scale-up batch. Exact field-level semantics are applied across coherent families, while unresolved duplicates, unsupported competition-specific concepts and fields lacking exact reference definitions remain fail-closed.
